title: Chromatic signal
description: Cobalt and vermilion type briefly split into clipped, displaced channels before returning to a clean headline.
useCase: A finite signal interruption for display typography.
reducedMotion: The control briefly changes color; the headline stays intact.
limitations: An authored 480ms text effect; not a live audio signal.
look: Pure white page with heavy, tightly tracked sans-serif display type, a cobalt line over a much larger vermilion line, and a small underlined monospace button.
motion: Pressing the button runs a 480 ms stepped glitch: cobalt and vermilion copies of each line flash in clipped horizontal slices, jumping sideways up to 11 px, then vanish.
adapt: The glitch is `:before`/`:after` copies built from `data-text` that run `sf-cs-break-a` and `sf-cs-break-b` (480 ms, `steps(1,end)`, `clip-path` slices plus `translateX`) while `data-pulse` is true; `disrupt` re-keys and times it. Replace the words and their `data-text` copies together.
